openGraph.title: Atharvaveda Book 2 – Hymns & Meaning
openGraph.description: Read Atharvaveda Book 2 with sacred hymns and explanations of healing and protection.

meaning.literal: That disease of yours I remove.
May vitality and strength be mine.
May Indra protect me from enemies.
I drive the disease far away.
May we live a hundred autumns.
May my life forces remain stable.
Let there be fearlessness for me.

meaning.interpretive: Disease is binding and can be removed.

meaning.literal: Let there be auspiciousness for me.

hymns.title: Charm for Protection of Life Energy
Charm for Removal of Fear and Anxiety

meaning.literal: Let there be fearlessness for me from all sides.

hymns.title: Charm for Removal of Sin and Impurity
Charm for Mental Clarity and Wisdom

meaning.literal: May there be auspiciousness for me.
May there be peace for us.
Let there be friends for me.

hymns.title: Charm for Protection of the Body
Charm for Longevity and Life Continuity

meaning.literal: May we live a hundred autumns.

verses.sanskrit: शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे
verses.transliteration: śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade

meaning.literal: May there be peace for bipeds and quadrupeds.
meaning.interpretive: Harmony extends to all living beings.

meaning.literal: Let there be fearlessness from all sides.

hymns.theme: Charm for Healing and Removal of Disease

meaning.literal: Let disease depart from the body.

hymns.theme: Charm Against Evil and Negative Forces

meaning.literal: I drive away demons with mantra.

hymns.theme: Charm for Longevity and Vital Energy

meaning.literal: Grant long life and protect the vital breaths.
May we live a hundred autumns.

verses.sanskrit: ओजः मे अस्तु बलं मे वर्धताम्
verses.transliteration: ojaḥ me astu balaṃ me vardhatām

meaning.literal: May vitality be mine, may strength increase.
I expel poison and burn it with fire.
Whatever poison has entered, let it go out.

hymns.theme: Charm for Peace and Universal Harmony

verses.sanskrit: शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे
verses.transliteration: śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade

meaning.literal: May there be peace for bipeds and quadrupeds.
May Mitra and Varuna grant us peace.
Let disease depart from the body.

hymns.theme: Charm for Protection of the Body

meaning.literal: May the gods protect my body from all sides.

hymns.theme: Charm for Purification and Release from Sin

meaning.literal: Let sin depart from me, go far away.
I am purified by the purifier.
May the waters bring us peace.
Let strength be in my body.
O fever, I expel you—go far away.
As a cut tree grows again.
So may my limb grow again.

hymns.theme: Charm Against Sorcery and Negative Influence

meaning.literal: Whatever sorcery is done, I turn it back.
Let the mind be united and thoughts together.
Let there be fearlessness from all sides.

hymns.theme: Charm for Restoration of Vital Energy

meaning.literal: May the sky bring us peace.
May the earth bring us peace.
May the mid-space bring us peace.
Let there be auspiciousness for me.
May Mitra and Varuna bring us peace.
